english.title: Assault a custody officer performing custodial duties at a contracted-out secure college
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) assaulted **(..SPECIFY SECURE COLLEGE CUSTODY OFFICER..), a secure college custody officer performing custodial duties at a contracted-out secure college, namely **(..SPECIFY SECURE COLLEGE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 14(1) and (2) of Schedule 10 to the Criminal Justice and Courts Act 2015.

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant assaulted **(..SPECIFY SECURE COLLEGE CUSTODY OFFICER..), a secure college custody officer performing custodial duties at a contracted-out secure college, namely **(..SPECIFY SECURE COLLEGE..).

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine

Note:
In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force (01/12/20), the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.

Time Limit For Prosecutions:
6 months
